articles.title: Infantino, Tashima and Diallo officially enter FIFA presidential race

Backed by UEFA, French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo wants to offer an alternative to Infantino’s leadership. He will face Japan’s Kozo Tashima, honorary president of the Japan Football Association. The election will take place on March 18, 2027 in Rabat, Morocco.

articles.title: Malaysia's unwanted refugees: The plight of the Rohingya
articles.description: On November 19, the International Court of Justice delivered a historic ruling: finding Myanmar guilty of committing genocide against the Rohingya in 2017. Malaysia has long been a supporter of the persecuted Muslim minority. But its role as a safe haven is coming to an end, amid a rise in hate speech and calls for the expulsion of Rohingya via social media.

articles.description: A nationwide strike was expected to disrupt schools, hospitals and local transport across Italy on Friday as workers and students began marching in dozens of cities to demand higher wages, lower living costs and greater social protections. The labor action coincided with an International Day of Student Mobilisation, with organisers planning demonstrations in more than 45 Italian cities. FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta reports from Rome, Italy.

articles.title: 'Our culture and identity': Deaf Nigerians embrace indigenous sign languages
articles.description: With a quick flick of the wrist, Umaru Zayyanu conveys the phrase "I am a Nigerian". But the 37-year-old is not signing, rather in the west African nation's official sign language. Instead, he's using Hausa sign language. Such indigenous sign languages abound in Africa's most populous country, where deaf people were communicating with each other long before the advent of formal sign language taught in deaf schools, in 1960.
